headline: Executive order directs the US government to impose sanctions related to the International Criminal Court.
what_it_does: This order puts sanctions in place connected to the International Criminal Court (ICC), a court based in The Hague that tries people accused of war crimes and similar offenses. No official summary was provided, so the specific people targeted and the exact penalties are not described here. US sanctions often include steps like freezing assets or limiting travel to the United States, but the details of this order are not confirmed from the title alone.
